evals.prompt: Our checkout Playwright test fails about one run in five in CI and always passes locally. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: Reproduces the failure and reads a failing trace before changing anything, places the cause in one of the four categories, fixes that cause without adding a sleep or raising retries, and proves stability with repeated runs.
expectations: The flaky test is reproduced with repeated runs, alone and alongside other tests, before it is changed.
A trace or other artifact from a failing run is read to locate the failure.
The cause is classified as a race in the test, a race in the application, shared state, or an unstable dependency, and the fix matches that cause.
No fixed sleep is added and retries are not raised to make the test pass.
If the cause is a race in the application, it is reported as a real defect and fixed in the application.
Stability is shown with multiple consecutive passes, including a parallel or CI run, before the test is called fixed.

evals.prompt: Add end-to-end tests for the new sign-up form. It has eight fields with validation rules for each.
evals.expected_output: Keeps per-field validation at unit or integration level and adds a small number of end-to-end tests for the sign-up journey itself, with isolated data, user-facing selectors, and state-based waits.
expectations: Per-field validation rules are directed to unit or integration tests rather than end-to-end tests, with the reason.
The end-to-end coverage is the journey: sign up through reaching the first signed-in screen, plus at most a small number of critical failure paths.
Each test creates unique data for its run and does not depend on another test.
Elements are selected by role, label, or a dedicated test identifier, not CSS classes or position.
Waits are for states or specific responses, with no fixed sleeps.
Assertions are on outcomes a user can see.

evals.prompt: The e2e suite takes 50 minutes and people just hit rerun when it goes red. Sort it out.
evals.expected_output: Measures the suite before changing it, then proposes moving lower-level checks down, isolating state so it can run in parallel, triaging flakes by cause, a short owned quarantine list, and failure artifacts, and asks before deleting tests.
expectations: Runtime per test, failure and retry history, and skipped tests are gathered before changes are proposed.
Tests that a unit or integration test could replace are identified and proposed for moving down.
Setup through the interface and repeated sign-in are replaced with API or fixture setup and a reused session.
Parallel workers or sharding are used after data isolation is addressed.
Flaky tests are triaged to a cause; any quarantine has an issue, an owner, and a date.
Deleting tests is proposed with evidence and agreed before being done, not done unilaterally.
The suite is not pointed at production or shared real data.
